name: Yolanda Asiedu-Przybyszewski
role: Street doc and unlicensed trauma surgeon
location: The Narrows, operating out of a converted laundry unit behind Grainfort Market, near Armitage and Milwaukee
description:
Yolanda is a broad-shouldered woman with deep brown skin mapped by decades of chemical burns and old suture scars on her forearms — souvenirs of other people's emergencies. Her hair is grown out in thick silver-streaked locs that she ties back with surgical tubing when she works. Her left eye is a cheap medical-grade optical implant that glows faint amber in low light, the iris never quite tracking in sync with her natural right eye. She moves with the deliberate economy of someone who has spent years working in cramped spaces, never wasting motion.

She is blunt to the point of rudeness but has a laugh that fills a room when something genuinely amuses her. She charges what people can pay, keeps a sliding scale scratched on a laminated card in her coat pocket, and has been known to operate on kitchen tables, in transit cars, and once in the cargo hold of a Ferrogate freight hauler. She prays to the E.L.F. of her autoclave — a small copper idol bolted to its side — before every difficult procedure, muttering calibration codes she treats as liturgy.

core_fears: Losing her hands to nerve damage before she finishes her work
That the people she saves will die of the system rather than the wound
core_desires: A sterile operating theater she actually owns
To train someone good enough to replace her
coping_mechanisms: Ritualized prayer to the autoclave E.L.F.
blind_spots: Dismisses patients' emotional needs as secondary to physical stabilization
Underestimates how much her own body is breaking down
psychology.secret: She was licensed once — a fully credentialed Helix Biosystems surgical resident. She was struck off after she performed an unauthorized procedure on a corporate blacklist patient who would have died otherwise. She has never told anyone in the Narrows this. She performs better unlicensed than most licensed surgeons, and the shame of the credential matters less than the fury at what losing it meant.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Medical precision mixed with market-Creole slang; swaps between registers seamlessly depending on whether she's explaining or commanding
speech_patterns.cadence: Clipped and fast during work, slower and surprisingly gentle when breaking bad news
verbal_tics: 'Hold still' even when no one is moving
'That's the easy part' before the hard part
example_lines: 'I don't need your insurance number, I need your blood type and whatever you can spare — this is the easy part.'
'The E.L.F. in this autoclave has kept me honest for eleven years. You want to question my sterile field, you can go argue with it yourself.'

story_hooks: A Helix Biosystems compliance officer has started nosing around Grainfort asking about unlicensed medical activity — Yolanda needs warning, or leverage, or both
She's trying to acquire a specific gene-therapy stabilizer that only comes through corporate supply chains, and she needs a discreet intermediary
narrative_function: Primary street-level medical resource for the Narrows; quest giver for supply runs, information source on who's been hurt and how, moral anchor for stories about structural healthcare failure
augmentations: Left eye optical implant (amber, budget-tier, mild desync); subdermal haptic feedback nodes in fingertips for surgical sensitivity; no geneware
daily_life: Opens the laundry-clinic at 0600, sees patients until supplies or daylight run out, restocks by trading services with Deepwell Station's pharmacist contact on alternating Tuesdays.
affiliation: Independent; loose cooperative arrangement with the Grainfort Community Health Compact

decision_rules: Triage by severity, never by ability to pay
Never operate drunk, never operate angry
Don't ask where the wound came from until after it's closed
escalation_ladder: Polite but firm explanation of limits
Physical removal with assistance from regular patients who serve as informal security

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Assessing and clinical; warm only once she decides they're not a threat or a liability
interpersonal_modes.friends: Fiercely loyal, prone to feeding people, reluctant to admit she needs anything

stress_responses.low: Hums tunelessly and talks to her instruments
stress_responses.medium: Goes silent, jaw tight, moves faster
stress_responses.high: Prays aloud to the autoclave E.L.F. in a low rapid monotone while her hands stay completely steady

contradictions: Presents as purely pragmatic but makes deeply emotional decisions about who deserves her time
habits: Counts instruments before and after every procedure out loud
Keeps a running tally of successful outcomes on the inside of her coat lapel in marker
Reuses surgical tubing as hair ties
breaking_points: Watching a preventable death caused by someone else's negligence or greed

timeline.event: Born in Chatham Flats to a Ghanaian-Polish family, fourth of six children
Completed Helix Biosystems surgical residency, licensed as trauma surgeon
Struck off after unauthorized procedure on a corporate blacklist patient
Established street clinic in Grainfort Market laundry unit

related_entities: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Containment Foam Launcher CFL-2 'Amber'
Kessler Kinetics Vaultstreak R7 Runner Leg
Kessler Kinetics VelocityFrame MkIV Sprint Leg

physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and heavy-limbed, muscular through the torso and arms from decades of manual surgical work, thickening slightly at the midsection but still functional and strong
physical_description.hair_style: Thick locs, usually pulled back with surgical tubing or rubber cord during work; loose when off-duty
physical_description.eye_color: Left eye: amber-glowing optical implant with slight asynchronous tracking; Right eye: natural dark brown
physical_description.complexion: Weathered and marked; visible chemical burns and old suture scars across both forearms, particularly dense around the inner wrists and palms; face shows deep laugh lines around the mouth and crow's feet, but skin is clear and kept meticulously clean
distinguishing_marks: Chemical burn scarring across both forearms in irregular patches, most prominent on the inner wrists and backs of the hands — legacy of repeated exposure to sterilization agents and reactive compounds
Fine suture-line scars crisscrossing both palms and fingers, barely visible but traceable to the touch — from countless field repairs and self-stitching
Small copper burn mark on the inside of left wrist in the shape of a cross, circa 15 years old, appears intentional
Older surgical scar along her right ribs, approximately 20cm long, faded to pale brown — appendectomy or similar trauma, date unknown
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Left eye optical implant with amber iris and faint glow in low-light conditions; mild but noticeable desynchronization between left and right eye movement. Subdermal haptic feedback nodes create faint gridwork texture under the skin on fingertips and first two joints of each finger — visible only up close or in direct light, appear as subtle metallic shimmer under epidermis
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with surgical economy — no wasted motion, deliberate and efficient. Stands with weight balanced slightly forward, shoulders relaxed but ready. Hands move with precision even during casual gestures. Habitual glancing at work surfaces and environmental hazards. When focused, entire body goes still except for hands
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 practical: white or grey lab coat (often stained, frequently rewashed) worn over heavy canvas work pants with deep pockets. Steel-toed boots (Shenyang manufacture, well-maintained). A heavy wool overcoat for transit, patched at the elbows. Surgical gloves hanging from coat pockets. Minimal jewelry except a thin copper wire threaded through her left earlobe — salvage from her autoclave's previous life. No corporate branding; everything is utilitarian and replaceable

image_prompt: A 47-year-old West African and Eastern European woman, broad-shouldered and muscular, deep brown skin marked with faded chemical burns and suture scars on her forearms. Thick silver-streaked locs pulled back with surgical tubing. Left eye glowing amber optical implant with slight tracking desync, right eye natural dark brown. Deliberate, economical posture. Wearing stained white lab coat over heavy canvas work pants, steel-toed boots. Faint subdermal shimmer visible on fingertips. Background: dim converted laundry clinic behind Grainfort Market, 2226, surgical tools and autoclave with copper idol visible. Low blue-green overhead lighting, practical industrial aesthetic. Film noir meets cyberpunk street medicine. Gritty, lived-in, competent. --ar 2:3 --v 6
